configuration:
actions: "enqueue, allocate, reclaim, preempt, backfill"
tiers:
- plugins:
  - name: priority
  - name: gang
    enablePreemptable: true
  - name: conformance
- plugins:
  - name: overcommit
  - name: drf
    enablePreemptable: true
  - name: deviceshare
    arguments:
      deviceshare.VGPUEnable: true
      deviceshare.NodeLockEnable: true
      deviceshare.SchedulePolicy: binpack
  - name: predicates
  - name: proportion
  - name: nodeorder
  - name: binpack
